id: 27_xTool MetalFab LaserWelder - Install and Set the Wire Feeder
title: 激光焊接机送丝机的安装与设置
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/27_xTool MetalFab LaserWelder - Install and Set the Wire Feeder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/27_xTool MetalFab LaserWelder - Install and Set the Wire Feeder/src.py

points.K2: 放在主机左侧，锁定脚轮
points.K3: 电缆连接：凸起朝上，拧紧
points.K4: 送丝轮尺寸对焊丝直径
points.K5: 拆装送丝轮，备用轮存好
points.K10: 合上压紧器，按表调压力
points.K11: 按送丝键送丝，过长回抽

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接机主机和一台送丝机之间招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a blank gray laser welding main unit and a blank wire feeder box and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲送丝机怎样安装和设置。
overlay: 激光焊接机送丝机的安装与设置

shots.scene: 电缆、送丝轮、焊丝盘、焊枪四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cable with two plugs, a drive roller, a wire spool and a welding gun. No people.
shots.narration: 连接、装轮、装丝、送丝，一步步来。

shots.scene: 阿杰推来一台送丝机，挠着头看主机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rolls a wire feeder next to the laser welding main unit and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 新送丝机到了，阿杰不知道怎么装。

shots.scene: 老李拿着一卷焊丝和工具走过来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over carrying a wire spool and a small toolbox.
shots.narration: 老李说：我们照步骤来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 连接、装轮、装丝、送丝，跟我走。

shots.scene: 送丝机旁边，焊接、清洗、切割三个图标，只有焊接打勾
shots.prompt_en: Beside the wire feeder, three icons: welding with a green check, cleaning and cutting greyed out. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝机只在激光焊接时用，清洗切割不用。

shots.section_title: 放在主机左侧，锁定脚轮
shots.scene: 老李把送丝机推到主机左侧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rolls the wire feeder to the left side of the main unit.
shots.narration: 送丝机放在主机左边，
overlay: 放在主机左侧，锁定脚轮

shots.section_title: 放在主机左侧，锁定脚轮
shots.scene: 老李踩下送丝机的脚轮锁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the caster brake on the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮都锁住。

shots.section_title: 电缆连接：凸起朝上，拧紧
shots.scene: 一根电缆两头接头一样，中间一个双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A cable with two identical round connectors at both ends and a double-headed arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这根电缆两头一样，不用分方向。
overlay: 电缆连接：凸起朝上，拧紧

shots.section_title: 电缆连接：凸起朝上，拧紧
shots.scene: 接头内壁的小凸起朝上，老李插进接口
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the small key on the inner wall of the connector faces up as the facility engineer pushes it into the port.
shots.narration: 接头里的小凸起朝上，对准插进去。

shots.section_title: 电缆连接：凸起朝上，拧紧
shots.scene: 老李拧紧接头的金属外圈
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws the metal collar of the connector tight.
shots.narration: 再把金属部分拧紧。

shots.section_title: 送丝轮尺寸对焊丝直径
shots.scene: 一卷焊丝和一副送丝轮并排
shots.prompt_en: A wire spool and a pair of drive rollers side by side on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 以1毫米焊丝配1毫米导轨为例。
overlay: 送丝轮尺寸对焊丝直径

shots.section_title: 送丝轮尺寸对焊丝直径
shots.scene: 送丝轮外侧的空白规格标记和焊丝盘之间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: A drive roller with a blank size mark on its outer side, an equal sign, and a wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝轮外侧的尺寸，要和焊丝直径一致。

shots.section_title: 拆装送丝轮，备用轮存好
shots.scene: 老李拧开送丝机门的旋钮，打开门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns the knob on the wire feeder door and swings it open.
shots.narration: 打开送丝机门，
overlay: 拆装送丝轮，备用轮存好

shots.section_title: 拆装送丝轮，备用轮存好
shots.scene: 老李松开红色压紧器，拆下螺丝，装上送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the red tensioners, removes the screws and fits the drive rollers.
shots.narration: 打开送丝驱动，拆螺丝，装好送丝轮。

shots.section_title: 拆装送丝轮，备用轮存好
shots.scene: 老李拧回螺丝，备用轮放到上方存放位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refastens the screws and puts the spare pair of rollers on the storage pegs above.
shots.narration: 拧回螺丝，另一对放在上方存好。

shots.scene: 老李合上右压紧器，松开驱动右侧螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the right tensioner and loosens the screw on the right side of the drive unit.
shots.narration: 合上右压紧器，松开右侧螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把送丝管没有卡扣的一端插进出口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inserts the plain end of the wire feeding tube into the wire outlet of the feeder.
shots.narration: 送丝管没有卡扣的一头插进送丝机，

shots.scene: 导嘴顶到侧板，老李拧紧螺丝，再打开压紧器
shots.prompt_en: The nozzle stem presses against the side plate; the facility engineer tightens the screw and then opens the tensioner.
shots.narration: 导嘴顶到底，拧紧螺丝，再打开压紧器。

shots.scene: 老李拧下盖子取下套筒，焊丝盘孔对准销装上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unscrews the cap, removes the sleeve and slides a wire spool on, its hole aligned with the pin.
shots.narration: 拧下盖子取下套筒，孔对准销装焊丝盘。

shots.scene: 示意图：焊丝从盘的下方出来，进入送丝驱动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow shows the wire leaving from the bottom of the spool into the drive unit. No people.
shots.narration: 方向要对：焊丝从盘的下方出来。

shots.scene: 大焊丝盘旁边，套筒被打叉；再装回盖子
shots.prompt_en: A large wire spool with the sleeve crossed out beside it, then a cap screwed back on. No people.
shots.narration: 大盘不装套筒；装好后拧回盖子。

shots.scene: 松手后焊丝弹开散乱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a released wire end springing loose and unraveling from the spool, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 引出焊丝时一直捏住，松手就会散开。

shots.scene: 老李一手捏住焊丝，一手用钳子剪掉弯头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pinches the wire with one hand and snips off the bent end with pliers in the other.
shots.narration: 用自备钳子，把弯曲的端头剪掉。

shots.scene: 老李捏住焊丝，穿进送丝驱动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pinches the wire and threads it into the drive unit.
shots.narration: 捏住焊丝穿进去，防止它往回缩。

shots.scene: 焊丝穿过两个送丝轮，进入送丝管
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the wire passes between the drive rollers and into the feeding tube. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻推，穿过送丝轮，进入送丝管。

shots.section_title: 合上压紧器，按表调压力
shots.scene: 老李合上两个压紧器，转动红色旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes both tensioners and turns their red knobs.
shots.narration: 合上压紧器，转旋钮调压力。
overlay: 合上压紧器，按表调压力

shots.section_title: 合上压紧器，按表调压力
shots.scene: 一张空白表格
shots.prompt_en: A blank adjustment table made of empty rows and columns with dots. No people.
shots.narration: 压力等级按表格来选。

shots.section_title: 按送丝键送丝，过长回抽
shots.scene: 送丝管带卡扣一端的铜导嘴特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small brass nozzle on the fastener end of the wire feeding tube. No people.
shots.narration: 出厂时送丝管末端装0.8/1.0导嘴。
overlay: 按送丝键送丝，过长回抽

shots.section_title: 按送丝键送丝，过长回抽
shots.scene: 送丝机顶上三个按键：送丝、电源灯、回抽
shots.prompt_en: Top panel of the wire feeder with three blank buttons: a feed icon, a power light and a retract icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按住送丝机上的送丝键，

shots.section_title: 按送丝键送丝，过长回抽
shots.scene: 焊丝盘逆时针匀速转动
shots.prompt_en: The wire spool turns steadily counterclockwise inside the feeder. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝盘会逆时针匀速转动。

shots.section_title: 按送丝键送丝，过长回抽
shots.scene: 焊丝从导嘴伸出，旁边回抽键图标
shots.prompt_en: The wire tip comes out of the brass nozzle; a retract button icon appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 丝从导嘴伸出就松手，过长按回抽。

shots.scene: 老李关上送丝机门，拧紧旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the wire feeder door and turns the knob to lock it.
shots.narration: 关好送丝机的门。

shots.scene: 老李打开卡扣，把送丝管滑到焊枪头上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the clamp and slides the wire feeding tube onto the tip of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 打开卡扣，把送丝管滑到焊枪头上。

shots.scene: 焊丝从焊嘴侧面的槽里伸出，老李合上卡扣
shots.prompt_en: The wire comes out through the groove on the side of the welding nozzle; the facility engineer closes the clamp.
shots.narration: 焊丝要从焊嘴的槽里伸出，合上卡扣。

shots.scene: 焊枪背面送丝键、回抽键、使能开关和指示灯
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the back of the welding gun handle with feed and retract buttons, an on-off switch and an indicator light. No people.
shots.narration: 用焊枪上的送丝回抽键微调长度。

shots.scene: 老李用扎带把送丝管固定在焊枪线缆上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens the wire feeding tube along the gun cable with a strap.
shots.narration: 把送丝管固定在焊枪线缆上，

shots.scene: 老李把焊枪放回支架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer places the welding gun back on its cradle.
shots.narration: 焊枪放回支架。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现四个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the wire feeder with four icons behind: a cable, a drive roller, a wire spool and a welding gun.
shots.narration: 放左侧锁轮，凸起朝上接电缆。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 轮丝匹配，焊丝盘方向对，捏丝不松手。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着焊枪
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the welding gun on its cradle.
shots.narration: 按表调压力，送丝到导嘴，装到焊枪。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰在送丝机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye beside the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 送丝机装好了，下次见！
